# A race for position draws everything

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`a-race-for-position-draws-everything` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](a-race-for-position-draws-everything.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Drawers in turn, each ranking its position against what all draw, draw everything at every step wherever what stands from nothing is least and there are at least two; where something left would stop what stands next, a drawer keeps it to stop it.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. Drawers in turn with no floor, each leaving at most what it is given, rank what they leave by position over the steps that remain: k times their own draw against what all draw from them on. A profile revises another for position, and is perfect for position where it revises itself. (`Becoming.Optimum.InTurn.drawnAll`, `Becoming.Optimum.InTurn.whole`, `Becoming.Optimum.InTurn.RevisesPosition`, `Becoming.Optimum.InTurn.PerfectPosition`)
2. What a drawer keeps for position it keeps for nothing: where its own later draw is the same, what passes on of it is at most it and all draw no less later, keeping lowers k times its own draw by k times what it keeps and what all draw by at most once that, so among two drawers or more a best response keeps nothing; drawing everything then places it no lower. (`Becoming.Optimum.InTurn.position_keeps_nothing`, `Becoming.Optimum.InTurn.position_nothing_best`, `Becoming.Optimum.InTurn.pass_le`)
3. At the last step every best response for position draws everything, whatever stands next; at a step after which every drawer draws everything, a drawer after the first draws everything where what stands from nothing is least. (`Becoming.Optimum.InTurn.drawn_first_none`, `Becoming.Optimum.InTurn.drawn_other_none`, `Becoming.Optimum.InTurn.drawnAll_none`, `Becoming.Optimum.InTurn.later_same`, `Becoming.Optimum.InTurn.drawnAll_grows`, `Becoming.Optimum.InTurn.position_step`, `Becoming.Optimum.InTurn.position_last`)
4. Where what stands from nothing is at most what stands from anything left and there are at least two drawers, every profile perfect for position draws everything at every step before the horizon, the base stands at what stands from nothing, a dependence above it met at the start breaking at the first step, and drawing everything is perfect. (`Becoming.Optimum.InTurn.position_perfect_ends`, `Becoming.Optimum.InTurn.position_perfect_draws`, `Becoming.Optimum.InTurn.position_levels`, `Becoming.Optimum.InTurn.zero_position_perfect`, `Becoming.Web.position_broken`, `Becoming.Web.drain_position_broken`)
5. Each premise binds: with one drawer every profile is perfect; in Stopping, where anything left stops what stands next, drawing everything is not perfect and every perfect profile has the second drawer keep the unit it is given at the first step. (`Becoming.Optimum.InTurn.position_one`, `Becoming.Optimum.InTurn.stopping`, `Becoming.Optimum.InTurn.Stopping.not_least`, `Becoming.Optimum.InTurn.Stopping.zero_not_perfect`, `Becoming.Optimum.InTurn.Stopping.perfect_keeps`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. k drawers in turn with no floor, each leaving at most what it is given; position over the steps that remain, k times the drawer's draw against what all draw; any law G of what stands next; for the drain, G t 0 ≤ G t x at every step and at least two drawers.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- That every race for position draws everything: where something left stops what stands next, drawing everything is not perfect. Witness: `Becoming.Optimum.InTurn.Stopping.zero_not_perfect`.
- Drawing at once ranking position, floors under a race for position, or a horizon the drawers do not know.
- That actual races are played in turn by drawers ranking position alone.
- That drawing everything is wrong.
- **Counterexample:** Stopping: from nothing two stand, from anything left nothing; with two drawers over two steps the second, given one unit at the first step, places itself higher by keeping it, so drawing everything is not perfect (Stopping.zero_not_perfect, Stopping.perfect_keeps). With one drawer every profile is perfect (position_one). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Optimum.lean)

<details><summary>Correspondence, dependencies, sources and history</summary>

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

The ranking is the count of RelativePosition read on the draws: a game zero-sum in positions, as relative-payoff maximizers in evolutionary game theory (Schaffer 1988) and spite (Hamilton 1970), here over a stock renewed by any law; with own draws ranked the drain is the open-access outcome of drawers in turn. Reading (the AI's): where position is what counts, keeping a stock for later pays no drawer, and what one leaves is kept only to deny it to another.

<a id="dependencies--依赖"></a>
### Dependencies

- **formal-reuse**: [drawers-in-turn](drawers-in-turn.md). Reuses InTurn's model and its laws of passing: pass, drawn, later, levels, pass_zero, pass_through, levels_through.
  - Output: What drawers in turn leave, draw and let stand; nothing passes a drawer leaving nothing.
  - Input: The race for position on the same model.
  - Preserved conditions: Drawers leaving at most what they are given. [Optimum.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Optimum.lean)
- related, not a proved adapter: [relative-position-is-zero-sum](relative-position-is-zero-sum.md). The count ranked here; a race of position cannot raise everyone, and this law says what drawers racing for it do to what they draw on.
- related, not a proved adapter: [a-rise-past-the-inflow-is-drawn-from-beyond](a-rise-past-the-inflow-is-drawn-from-beyond.md). Where a rise is rewarded, what passes the inflow is drawn from beyond; where position is rewarded, drawers draw everything.
